title: Mastering Personal Finance in India
summary: A practical 4-week guide for adults in India to take control of their income, expenses, investments, and taxes with confidence.

days.title: Mapping Your Net Worth
objectives: List all personal assets and liabilities
Calculate total net worth in Indian Rupees

days.title: Tracking Income and Fixed Expenses
objectives: Categorize monthly income sources
Identify and list all fixed monthly expenses

days.title: Controlling Variable Expenses
objectives: Analyze discretionary spending habits
Set realistic monthly caps for variable categories

days.title: Applying the 50/30/20 Rule
objectives: Allocate income into needs, wants, and savings using the 50/30/20 framework

days.title: Building an Emergency Fund Target
objectives: Calculate the required size of a 6-month emergency fund
Select safe, liquid parking spaces for emergency cash

days.title: Evaluating Good Debt vs Bad Debt
objectives: Differentiate between wealth-building and depreciating consumer debt

days.title: Credit Cards and CIBIL Scores
objectives: Explain how CIBIL scores are calculated
List actions to maintain a credit score above 750

days.title: Choosing Debt Payoff Strategies
objectives: Compare the debt avalanche and debt snowball methods
Choose a payoff strategy for existing liabilities

days.title: Optimizing Bank Accounts
objectives: Select appropriate savings and current accounts based on interest and fees
Identify hidden banking charges

days.title: Understanding Digital Payments Security
objectives: Apply safe practices for UPI and net banking
Identify common financial scams in India

days.title: Beating Inflation with Asset Allocation
objectives: Calculate the impact of inflation on purchasing power
Define personal risk tolerance

days.title: Fixed Income: FDs, RDs, and EPF
objectives: Compare returns of Fixed Deposits, Recurring Deposits, and Employee Provident Fund

days.title: Introduction to Mutual Funds
objectives: Explain the difference between direct and regular mutual fund plans
Distinguish active from passive funds

days.title: Setting Up a SIP
objectives: Calculate compound growth using a Systematic Investment Plan calculator
Execute a monthly SIP setup process

days.title: Basics of Direct Equity
objectives: Explain basic stock market terminology like P/E ratio and market cap
Differentiate stocks from mutual funds

days.title: Securing Life Insurance
objectives: Calculate required life cover using the human life value or income multiplier method
Differentiate term insurance from ULIPs

days.title: Health Insurance Essentials
objectives: Evaluate health insurance policies for room rent limits and copay clauses
Calculate optimal health cover amount

days.title: Tax Planning Under Old and New Regimes
objectives: Compare income tax liabilities under the old and new tax regimes in India
List common tax deduction sections like 80C and 80D

days.title: Planning for Retirement
objectives: Calculate the corpus needed for retirement based on current expenses
Utilize NPS for retirement savings

days.title: Building Your Lifetime Financial Masterplan
objectives: Draft a comprehensive, personal financial roadmap for the next 5 years
Establish an annual financial review habit
